properties.displayName: UAV S3 - SATCOM MITM (IntegrityStatus Violation / RTT Spike / Jamming)
properties.description: SATCOM 링크에서 IntegrityStatus != 'ok', RTT > 650ms, JamIndicator > 0.15, SrcAddr 변경, Seq 대폭 건너뜀을 탐지. 실측 기반 임계값(정상: RTT 592~608ms / JamIndicator max 0.05). MITRE: T1557 AitM, T1565 Data Manipulation. ICS: T0830, T0887 (description 참조)
properties.query:
let rttThreshold = toscalar(
    _GetWatchlist('UAV_Threshold_List')
    | where ThresholdKey == 'MaxRttMs_SATCOM'
    | project toreal(Value));
let jamThreshold = toscalar(
    _GetWatchlist('UAV_Threshold_List')
    | where ThresholdKey == 'MaxJamIndicator'
    | project toreal(Value));
let knownSrcAddr = dynamic(["10.60.0.10"]);
let alertWindow = 10m;
let IntegrityAlert =
    UAVSatcomLink_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where IntegrityStatus != 'ok'
    | summarize Count=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated)
        by UAVId, LinkId, SessionId, IntegrityStatus
    | extend TriggerReason = strcat("SATCOM_무결성_위반_", IntegrityStatus)
    | extend Severity = "High";
let RttAlert =
    UAVSatcomLink_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where toreal(RttMs) > rttThreshold
    | summarize AvgRtt=avg(toreal(RttMs)), MaxRtt=max(toreal(RttMs)),
        Count=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated)
        by UAVId, LinkId, SessionId
    | extend TriggerReason = strcat("SATCOM_RTT_급증_", tostring(toint(MaxRtt)), "ms")
    | extend Severity = "Medium";
let JamAlert =
    UAVSatcomLink_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where toreal(JamIndicator) > jamThreshold
    | summarize MaxJam=max(toreal(JamIndicator)), Count=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated)
        by UAVId, LinkId, SessionId
    | extend TriggerReason = strcat("SATCOM_재밍_JamIndicator_", tostring(MaxJam))
    | extend Severity = "High";
let SrcAddrAlert =
    UAVSatcomLink_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where SrcAddr !in (knownSrcAddr)
    | project TimeGenerated, UAVId, LinkId, SessionId, SrcAddr, DstAddr
    | extend TriggerReason = strcat("SATCOM_비인가_SrcAddr_", SrcAddr)
    | extend Severity = "High"
    | summarize FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), Count=count() by UAVId, LinkId, SessionId, TriggerReason, Severity;
union IntegrityAlert, JamAlert, SrcAddrAlert, RttAlert
| extend IncidentType = "S3_SATCOM_MITM"
| project FirstSeen, UAVId, LinkId, SessionId, TriggerReason, Severity, IncidentType
| order by Severity desc, FirstSeen asc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S3 - SATCOM MITM (IntegrityStatus Violation / RTT Spike / Jamming) - {{UAVId}}
